ratnik_emr_camo.notes: EMR ("tsifra", Ratnik) summer, matched to photos of issue fabric: light grey-green (sage) ground with a faint light-khaki tone, medium-green pixel blotches (~1/3 of the cloth; macro shapes ~5-15 cm with stepped, ragged pixel edges and ground-coloured holes), small dark-brown and brownish-black pixel clusters / chains scattered through and along the green. Square ~5 mm pixels on the cloth (uniform atlas ~1 mm/texel: ~5 texels per pixel). Palette = sRGB albedo as rendered (EMR materials use base colour factor 1).

mm14_camo.notes: MM-14: five-tone digital pattern (light beige, light green, swamp green, grey-green, dark grey); slightly horizontally elongated shapes.

multicam.notes: UA plate carriers / helmet covers / some tops; organic 6-tone pattern, procedural approximation.

6b46_plate_carrier.notes: Ratnik lightweight plate carrier: front/back plate bags (Granit-type plates), cummerbund, padded shoulder straps, MOLLE, drag handle. Modelled: plate bags ~300 x 336 mm front / 310 x 344 mm back, 22-26 mm thick with plate bulge and shooter's-cut corners; cummerbund 180 mm; 6Sh117-style pouches: 3 flapped double AK mag pouches (85x155x62 mm, Fastex), radio pouch (R-187 style radio + antenna), grenade pouches, IFAK, hydration and dump pouch.

ua_plate_carrier.notes: JPC-style: slimmer plate bags (280 x 316 mm), integrated open-top triple mag shingle with visible AK mag bases, admin pouch with UA flag patch, CAT tourniquet, radio on the cummerbund, IFAK, grenade pouch; MultiCam + coyote webbing.

soldier_ru.notes: body_A/B/C are alternative variants (one visible at a time; A default). hands vs gloves are alternatives. helmet_A/B/C/D alternatives (see combos[*].helmet_desc). backpack, legband_L, kneepads, pouches_back off by default. Gear is skinned to the shared skeleton: vest / plate carrier to the trunk chain only (Hips..Spine1; the shoulder straps and the top corners share up to 50 % with the clavicles, no arm / neck influence, so nothing flares out when the arms are raised), pouches rigid per pouch, helmet rigid to Head, kneepads rigid to *Leg, tape bands follow the sleeve weights. All textured materials use colour factor 1. Vertex colours (COLOR_0) on gear carry baked ambient occlusion. RU vest = 6B45/6B46 (Ratnik) style: front and back sections run from the collar bones / shoulder blades down to the belt line (1.015 m, trouser waist ~1.0 m), soft side sections wrap the waist (to 1.26 m), shooter's cut front / armhole cut back; 6Sh117-style pouches: three double mag pouches low on the front, radio + grenade pouch above, grenade pouches / IFAK on the sides. Armour add-on nodes: armor_groin = soft groin protector flap hung from the bottom of the front section (RU) / under the plate carrier (UA), conforming to the lower belly and the fronts of both thighs, skinned Hips -> 85 % average of both UpLeg bones at the bottom edge (it is lifted / pushed forward by the thighs); armor_arms = soft shoulder (deltoid) protectors sewn to the shoulder straps, rigid with the upper arm, top edge shared 45 % with the clavicle bone.  Presets: see combos[*].groin_protector / shoulder_protectors (standard presets: some with a groin flap, some with shoulder protectors; assault presets mostly both).

soldier_ru.crew_notes: Armoured-vehicle crew presets `crew_combo_<n>` (+ `crew_combo_<n>_tape`, + `_LOD1` siblings): same skeleton, skin and sockets as the infantry, ONE material each (soldier_atlas_crew_ru: its own 2048^2 atlas, base colour / normal / ORM like the infantry atlas), so 2 draw calls per crewman. Look: one-piece crew coverall (RU: olive-khaki or EMR) with full-length front zip, slanted chest zip pockets, thigh pockets, quilted knee / elbow pads, elastic waist and ankle tabs, flag patch on the left sleeve; Soviet padded tanker helmet (shlemofon TSh: longitudinal padded rolls, forehead roll, ear-phone housings, chin strap) black or olive, throat microphone band with the intercom cable; waist belt with a PM flap holster on the right hip and a utility pouch; light soft armour vest on presets 1 and 2; gloves or bare hands; boots; armbands / right thigh band with the recolourable `tape` material exactly like the infantry presets; no rucksack, no rifle (pistol: pm.glb in weapon_socket). No per-part crew nodes are written (only the presets), hidden by default (extras.combo = true).
soldier_ru.combo_notes: Pre-combined presets for rendering (2 draw calls per soldier): `<name>` = ONE SkinnedMesh / ONE primitive with material soldier_atlas_ru (2048^2 atlas: base colour JPEG, normal PNG, ORM PNG [R=AO 1, G=roughness, B=metalness]) merging every visible part (body/head/eyes, hands or gloves, boots, vest, pouches, helmet, backpack, kneepads, assault armour, headset, balaclava); `<name>_tape` = the preset's arm/leg bands with the recolourable `tape` material; `<name>_LOD1` / `<name>_tape_LOD1` ~28% / ~40%. Same skeleton/skin as the per-part nodes, so all sockets keep working. extras.combo = true, hidden by default (show exactly one preset + its _tape and hide all per-part nodes). Camouflage is identical to the per-part materials: the uniform is copied texel-for-texel (90-degree turns only) at ~1.0 mm/texel (EMR / MM-14 pixels stay 3.5-6 texels wide), tiling gear camo is mapped into one wrap-padded repeat region per material at the same pattern scale (gear triangles never cross a repeat: components are shifted by whole tiles), vertex colours keep the baked AO. Balaclava presets drop the covered face triangles. Presets wearing the vest also drop the uniform triangles completely covered by it (every corner under the vest, skinned to the trunk).
soldier_ru.tape_alt_material: tape (white #e9e9e4); for red tape set tape colour to #b01e1e (tape_red); materials named `tape` are recolourable
soldier_ru.sling_notes: Slung weapons (v9, src/game/soldier.js stow()): a weapon not in his hands hangs on its sling on his back - parent it to the socket named in the visible preset's extras.preset.sling_socket (weapon_socket_sling / _pouch / _pack / _ruck: Spine1 children, measured onto the outer surface of that preset's back gear) with identity, and show extras.preset.sling_node (skinned 32 mm webbing sling, hidden by default) while anything hangs there. The rifle lies on its left side diagonally across the back, muzzle up behind the right shoulder, butt at the left hip; the sling runs from the front swivel over the right shoulder, across the chest to the left flank and round to the rear swivel. Used for: the RPG gunner's AK (and his RPG-7 when he has the AK in his hands: same line, turned optic-out, origin +0.16 m gun-Y / +0.18 m gun-Z), the RPG-22 shooter's rifle while the launcher is up, medics / draggers / wounded, FPV assistant; ATGM crew lay the rifle down beside them during atgm_* clips. weapon_socket_back (ATGM tubes / folded launchers) is moved per man along the chest axis so that kit rests on his preset's back gear (Soldier.fitBackKit). v10 sling: one continuous 32 mm strap from the front swivel over the right shoulder beside the neck, diagonally across the chest to the left hip, round the left flank at belt height to the rear swivel; every sample on a ray from inside the body is pulled taut against the outermost surface (body, vest, front / side pouches, radio pouches, the class's back gear) + 4.5 mm, so it lies on the kit and bridges hollows straight (no plateaus / gaps, no longer under the left arm); the strap ends wrap round the AK-74M swivel bars, sewn fold-back loops, slider + adjuster buckles.  AK-12: soldier.js moves it 3 cm up the sling line so its front swivel meets the strap.
soldier_ru.head_shading_notes: Helmet / headset / retention occlusion is baked per preset into the COLOR_0 vertex colours of the head, eyes and balaclava (sky-weighted hemisphere AO against that preset's helmet_*, hs_* and retention_* nodes): brow, eyes, temples and ears darken under the brim and the cups.
soldier_ru.v6_notes: v10 (2026-11): comms + ear protection per preset (comms.py: nodes hs_<preset> on the head - ear cups with leatherette seals, ARC rail adapters on FAST-type helmets or a headband yoke going up under the rim, knobs, mic boom for leaders - and radio_<preset> on the plate carrier - handheld radio in an open-top pouch with antenna, PTT on the left shoulder strap, cables cup -> neck -> PTT -> radio; cups fitted to each preset's own head and helmet: centred on the ear, pulled inside the shell's inner surface where a rim covers them, lowered under low rims); painted helmet shells (helmets.py, `hg_<fac>` charts in the preset atlas: cover seams + stitching, hem, creases, band shadow, bolt heads, labels, FAST loop-velcro fields, paint wear / chips / scratches on bare shells; the geometry seams / velcro strips were removed, -0.3..-0.6 k tris per helmet); 4-point retention harness per helmet x body variant (retention_<helmet>_<body>: front / rear straps round the ear to a junction, chin strap along the jaw to a chin cup, side-release buckle, nape cradle + pad with a ratchet dial on modern helmets; SSh-68: 2-point leather strap), projected onto that face (no floating, no skin penetration), scrim on the UA PASGT-type and RU 6B7; joint skin-weight clean-up (joints.py: diffusion round shoulders / elbows / hips / knees, measured with joints_check.py over every clip: mean deformation badness -28 %); rifle sling rebuilt (taut, continuous, over the right shoulder, across the chest to the left hip, round the flank to the rear swivel; strap ends wrap the swivels; adjuster + slider). v9: packs (packs.py): rucksack (UA 3-day assault pack / RU Ratnik-type raid pack) and assault pack rebuilt with painted detail - one textured material per faction (pack_ua / pack_ru, placed in the preset atlas like the uniform): every pack / pocket face has its own chart with the gear camo plus a baked height field (coil zips with sliders and pulls, PALS webbing rows with bar tacks, laser-cut MOLLE, bound edges, stitched seams, velcro ID field with a UA flag patch, flat compression straps, grommets, labels) as normal map + cavity AO; geometry: side-release buckles, strap bridges, grab handles, karimat foam roll under the rucksack (spiral ends), MPL-50 entrenching tool on the RU rucksack, hydration tube and CAT tourniquet on the UA rucksack straps (webbing MOLLE rows moved from geometry into the texture: tris about unchanged). v8: wrists (wrist.py): sleeve ends cinched round the wrist with a 3.4 mm rounded hem + shadowed inner facing (the sleeves were open 6 cm tubes before), forearm skin continues 8 cm inside the sleeve, gloves with a cuff tucked under the sleeve (UA dark neoprene + velcro tab, RU knit) and a dark base-layer cuff; hem / tube skinned forearm-only behind the wrist (wrist_check.py: 111 clips, no poke-through). v7: soft shaded cloth folds (smooth crease profile, tapered), UA open-top pouch mags turned broad-side out / feed lips down, soft blast smudges. v6 (2026-11): baggier layered uniform (build_soldier.thicken_uniform: per-vertex offset field, trunk 8-15 mm, sleeves 10-18 mm with bunching at the cuffs, trousers 11-28 mm: full thigh / seat, bunching above and below the knee pads, blousing over the boot tops, filled cargo / sleeve pockets; same topology, UVs and weights), re-baked uniform textures (rebake_v6.py: ragged printed MM-14 / EMR pixels with per-pixel tone variation, stronger folds, mud / grime / wear gradients), fuller pouches. Runtime damage (src/game/soldierDamage.js): materials soldier_atlas_* / *_camo / skin_* are patched once (defines SOLDIER_DMG, DMG_BASE = real bone count); each soldier's skinned meshes get 4 extra data bones (__dmg0..3, not in the scene graph) whose matrices carry up to 4 wounds (bind-space centre / radius, bandage band, code) + mud / rips / soot / back mud / fade / tint.
soldier_ru.comms_notes: Comms (v10, comms.py): every preset lists `comms_role` ('leader' | 'rifleman'), `comms`, `headset_desc`, `radio_desc`; its parts include hs_<preset> (head-mounted, rigid with Head; absent / empty when he wears no ear protection) and radio_<preset> (plate-carrier mounted, vest weights; the headset cable blends Head -> Neck -> vest).  src/game/soldier.js picks a preset with comms_role 'leader' for role.leader soldiers (squad / assault leaders, ATGM gunner, FPV pilot) and a non-leader preset for everyone else.  Loadouts (2022-25 photos): UA - Peltor ComTac III-type on ARC rails + mic boom + AN/PRC-152 (leaders), Earmor M31 on rails / M32 with headband + Motorola R7 / DP4400 or Baofeng UV-5R + PTT, cheap passive muffs, some without; RU - Earmor M32 / clones + mic boom + Azart R-187-P1 (leaders), GSSh-01 (Ratnik) + Baofeng UV-82, Kenwood-type handhelds, Baofeng UV-5R in a chest pouch without a headset, mobilised men without. Retention harness: retention_<helmet>_<body> (in the presets).

soldier_ua.crew_notes: Armoured-vehicle crew presets `crew_combo_<n>` (+ `crew_combo_<n>_tape`, + `_LOD1` siblings): same skeleton, skin and sockets as the infantry, ONE material each (soldier_atlas_crew_ua: its own 2048^2 atlas, base colour / normal / ORM like the infantry atlas), so 2 draw calls per crewman. Look: one-piece crew coverall (UA: MM-14 or olive) with full-length front zip, slanted chest zip pockets, thigh pockets, quilted knee / elbow pads, elastic waist and ankle tabs, flag patch on the left sleeve; Soviet padded tanker helmet (shlemofon TSh: longitudinal padded rolls, forehead roll, ear-phone housings, chin strap) black or olive, throat microphone band with the intercom cable; waist belt with a PM flap holster on the right hip and a utility pouch; light soft armour vest on presets 1 and 2; gloves or bare hands; boots; armbands / right thigh band with the recolourable `tape` material exactly like the infantry presets; no rucksack, no rifle (pistol: pm.glb in weapon_socket). No per-part crew nodes are written (only the presets), hidden by default (extras.combo = true).
soldier_ua.combo_notes: Pre-combined presets for rendering (2 draw calls per soldier): `<name>` = ONE SkinnedMesh / ONE primitive with material soldier_atlas_ua (2048^2 atlas: base colour JPEG, normal PNG, ORM PNG [R=AO 1, G=roughness, B=metalness]) merging every visible part (body/head/eyes, hands or gloves, boots, vest, pouches, helmet, backpack, kneepads, assault armour, headset, balaclava); `<name>_tape` = the preset's arm/leg bands with the recolourable `tape` material; `<name>_LOD1` / `<name>_tape_LOD1` ~28% / ~40%. Same skeleton/skin as the per-part nodes, so all sockets keep working. extras.combo = true, hidden by default (show exactly one preset + its _tape and hide all per-part nodes). Camouflage is identical to the per-part materials: the uniform is copied texel-for-texel (90-degree turns only) at ~1.3 mm/texel (EMR / MM-14 pixels stay 3.5-6 texels wide), tiling gear camo is mapped into one wrap-padded repeat region per material at the same pattern scale (gear triangles never cross a repeat: components are shifted by whole tiles), vertex colours keep the baked AO. Balaclava presets drop the covered face triangles. Presets wearing the vest also drop the uniform triangles completely covered by it (every corner under the vest, skinned to the trunk).
soldier_ua.sling_notes: Slung weapons (v9, src/game/soldier.js stow()): a weapon not in his hands hangs on its sling on his back - parent it to the socket named in the visible preset's extras.preset.sling_socket (weapon_socket_sling / _pouch / _pack / _ruck: Spine1 children, measured onto the outer surface of that preset's back gear) with identity, and show extras.preset.sling_node (skinned 32 mm webbing sling, hidden by default) while anything hangs there. The rifle lies on its left side diagonally across the back, muzzle up behind the right shoulder, butt at the left hip; the sling runs from the front swivel over the right shoulder, across the chest to the left flank and round to the rear swivel. Used for: the RPG gunner's AK (and his RPG-7 when he has the AK in his hands: same line, turned optic-out, origin +0.16 m gun-Y / +0.18 m gun-Z), the RPG-22 shooter's rifle while the launcher is up, medics / draggers / wounded, FPV assistant; ATGM crew lay the rifle down beside them during atgm_* clips. weapon_socket_back (ATGM tubes / folded launchers) is moved per man along the chest axis so that kit rests on his preset's back gear (Soldier.fitBackKit). v10 sling: one continuous 32 mm strap from the front swivel over the right shoulder beside the neck, diagonally across the chest to the left hip, round the left flank at belt height to the rear swivel; every sample on a ray from inside the body is pulled taut against the outermost surface (body, vest, front / side pouches, radio pouches, the class's back gear) + 4.5 mm, so it lies on the kit and bridges hollows straight (no plateaus / gaps, no longer under the left arm); the strap ends wrap round the AK-74M swivel bars, sewn fold-back loops, slider + adjuster buckles.  AK-12: soldier.js moves it 3 cm up the sling line so its front swivel meets the strap.
soldier_ua.head_shading_notes: Helmet / headset / retention occlusion is baked per preset into the COLOR_0 vertex colours of the head, eyes and balaclava (sky-weighted hemisphere AO against that preset's helmet_*, hs_* and retention_* nodes): brow, eyes, temples and ears darken under the brim and the cups.
soldier_ua.v6_notes: v10 (2026-11): comms + ear protection per preset (comms.py: nodes hs_<preset> on the head - ear cups with leatherette seals, ARC rail adapters on FAST-type helmets or a headband yoke going up under the rim, knobs, mic boom for leaders - and radio_<preset> on the plate carrier - handheld radio in an open-top pouch with antenna, PTT on the left shoulder strap, cables cup -> neck -> PTT -> radio; cups fitted to each preset's own head and helmet: centred on the ear, pulled inside the shell's inner surface where a rim covers them, lowered under low rims); painted helmet shells (helmets.py, `hg_<fac>` charts in the preset atlas: cover seams + stitching, hem, creases, band shadow, bolt heads, labels, FAST loop-velcro fields, paint wear / chips / scratches on bare shells; the geometry seams / velcro strips were removed, -0.3..-0.6 k tris per helmet); 4-point retention harness per helmet x body variant (retention_<helmet>_<body>: front / rear straps round the ear to a junction, chin strap along the jaw to a chin cup, side-release buckle, nape cradle + pad with a ratchet dial on modern helmets; SSh-68: 2-point leather strap), projected onto that face (no floating, no skin penetration), scrim on the UA PASGT-type and RU 6B7; joint skin-weight clean-up (joints.py: diffusion round shoulders / elbows / hips / knees, measured with joints_check.py over every clip: mean deformation badness -28 %); rifle sling rebuilt (taut, continuous, over the right shoulder, across the chest to the left hip, round the flank to the rear swivel; strap ends wrap the swivels; adjuster + slider). v9: packs (packs.py): rucksack (UA 3-day assault pack / RU Ratnik-type raid pack) and assault pack rebuilt with painted detail - one textured material per faction (pack_ua / pack_ru, placed in the preset atlas like the uniform): every pack / pocket face has its own chart with the gear camo plus a baked height field (coil zips with sliders and pulls, PALS webbing rows with bar tacks, laser-cut MOLLE, bound edges, stitched seams, velcro ID field with a UA flag patch, flat compression straps, grommets, labels) as normal map + cavity AO; geometry: side-release buckles, strap bridges, grab handles, karimat foam roll under the rucksack (spiral ends), MPL-50 entrenching tool on the RU rucksack, hydration tube and CAT tourniquet on the UA rucksack straps (webbing MOLLE rows moved from geometry into the texture: tris about unchanged). v8: wrists (wrist.py): sleeve ends cinched round the wrist with a 3.4 mm rounded hem + shadowed inner facing (the sleeves were open 6 cm tubes before), forearm skin continues 8 cm inside the sleeve, gloves with a cuff tucked under the sleeve (UA dark neoprene + velcro tab, RU knit) and a dark base-layer cuff; hem / tube skinned forearm-only behind the wrist (wrist_check.py: 111 clips, no poke-through). v7: soft shaded cloth folds (smooth crease profile, tapered), UA open-top pouch mags turned broad-side out / feed lips down, soft blast smudges. v6 (2026-11): baggier layered uniform (build_soldier.thicken_uniform: per-vertex offset field, trunk 8-15 mm, sleeves 10-18 mm with bunching at the cuffs, trousers 11-28 mm: full thigh / seat, bunching above and below the knee pads, blousing over the boot tops, filled cargo / sleeve pockets; same topology, UVs and weights), re-baked uniform textures (rebake_v6.py: ragged printed MM-14 / EMR pixels with per-pixel tone variation, stronger folds, mud / grime / wear gradients), fuller pouches. Runtime damage (src/game/soldierDamage.js): materials soldier_atlas_* / *_camo / skin_* are patched once (defines SOLDIER_DMG, DMG_BASE = real bone count); each soldier's skinned meshes get 4 extra data bones (__dmg0..3, not in the scene graph) whose matrices carry up to 4 wounds (bind-space centre / radius, bandage band, code) + mud / rips / soot / back mud / fade / tint.
soldier_ua.comms_notes: Comms (v10, comms.py): every preset lists `comms_role` ('leader' | 'rifleman'), `comms`, `headset_desc`, `radio_desc`; its parts include hs_<preset> (head-mounted, rigid with Head; absent / empty when he wears no ear protection) and radio_<preset> (plate-carrier mounted, vest weights; the headset cable blends Head -> Neck -> vest).  src/game/soldier.js picks a preset with comms_role 'leader' for role.leader soldiers (squad / assault leaders, ATGM gunner, FPV pilot) and a non-leader preset for everyone else. soldier_anims.contents: skeleton + sockets + clips only (no meshes); tracks: Hips translation + rotation of all 31 joints, 30 fps, linear
soldier_anims.in_place: loops have horizontal root motion stripped (Hips keeps vertical bob); deaths and the vehicle exits (hatch_exit*, dismount_*) keep root motion and end on the root
soldier_anims.time_scaling: ground_speed_mps is the clip's natural speed; the game time-scales by speed / ground_speed_mps. walk_rifle is a native 1.47 m/s tactical walk (CMU 07_01, pelvis lowered, soft knees, rifle at low ready; game 1.55 m/s = x1.06) and run_rifle a native 4.17 m/s weighty combat run (CMU 16_45, bent knees, 12 deg lean, rifle at port; game 4.2 m/s = x1.01). The planted foot is pinned to the ground sliding back at exactly ground_speed_mps, so there is no foot sliding at those speeds.

rifle_fire.clips: fire_stand / fire_crouch / fire_prone / fire_peek_left / fire_peek_right / fire_peek_crouch_left / fire_peek_crouch_right
rifle_fire.cycle: each clip is ONE shot (0.133 s, 5 frames): event shot at 0.0 (muzzle flash / tracer / sound), peak kick at 0.033 s (butt drives the shoulder ~2 cm back, muzzle climbs ~3 deg pivoting at the butt, chest and cheek absorb), recovered by 0.133 s. First and last frame == the matching aim pose (aim_stand / aim_crouch / aim_prone / peek_* frame 0), so the clip loops seamlessly during a burst (one recoil cycle per loop) and cross-fades back into the aim clip.

peeks.clips: peek_left / peek_right (standing), peek_crouch_left / peek_crouch_right (kneeling), 2 s loops
peeks.geometry: leaning out around a wall corner while aiming straight ahead (+Z): trunk rolled 22-28 deg about the aim axis to the named side (the soldier's own left / right), weight on that leg, feet / knee planted, rifle on the right shoulder canted 11-12 deg (right peeks) / 32-40 deg (left peeks: the cheek stays on the stock), right eye on the sight line, butt in the shoulder pocket (< 1.5 cm). The head sits 0.23-0.36 m to the lean side of the root (events.head_out_m): with the corner edge ~0.15 m to the lean side of the root, head and rifle are past the edge and the far shoulder / hip stay behind it.

cover.cover_duck: deep squat tight behind a low wall / window sill in front (+Z, wall face ~0.42 m ahead of the root), head below a 0.9-1.0 m parapet (see events.head_top_m), rifle across the thighs, muzzle to his left along the wall (clear of the head, also through the duck <-> aim cross-fades), flinches (events.flinch); 3 s loop
cover.pinned_prone: flat prone, face down, left forearm over the helmet, rifle lying on its side beside the body (still in weapon_socket), flinches (events.flinch); 3 s loop

launchers.socket: weapon_socket (identity) for both rpg22.glb and rpg7.glb in aim_launcher / aim_launcher_kneel / fire_launcher
launchers.authored_for: RPG-22: right eye on the rear-sight line, tube underside on the right trapezius, right hand on the tube under the firing housing (= launcher origin), left palm under the front tube (rpg22 grip_L).

rpg7_offset.note: RPG-7 also fits with identity: its tube axis is 7 mm higher and its PGO-7 eyepiece sits 5 cm left / 4 cm below the eye (head over the tube instead of beside it). For an exact PGO-7 sight picture offset the launcher by [-0.051, 0.042, 0.0] (launcher local), at the cost of a 4 cm gap above the shoulder.

launchers.sequence: launcher_raise[_kneel] (0.8 s, plays once: ready stance with the launcher carried low in both hands -> on the right shoulder; last frame == aim_launcher[_kneel] frame 0) -> aim_launcher[_kneel] (loop) -> fire_launcher[_kneel] (1.0 s, plays once from the aim pose: shot / backblast at 0.05 s, tube jump, head flinch, standing half step back; recoil done by ~0.45 s, then the head comes off the sight and the empty tube dips). Attach rpg22.glb to weapon_socket when the raise starts.

riding.frame: ride_sit_edge / ride_sit_deck / ride_aim: root = ride_seat_N empty (point on the sitting surface under the pelvis), +Z = seat facing; Hips joint 0.118 m above and 0.035 m behind the seat point; place the soldier root exactly on the seat empty (position + heading), no ground snapping.
riding.edge: thighs along +Z, knees ~0.42 m out, shins angled ~30 deg outward (clears the BTR's sloped upper hull), rifle across the lap
riding.deck: knees up, feet flat on the deck ~0.47 m ahead, rifle upright between the knees, butt on the deck
riding.dismount_jump: dismount_jump = dismount_jump_btr (2.2 s) / dismount_jump_tank (1.9 s): start == ride_sit_edge frame 0 at the seat, end == crouch_walk frame 0; see soldier_anims.vehicle_exits

medical.drag: drag_wounded (dragger) and being_dragged (casualty) share a 2.5 s loop. Casualty root = dragger root + 1.0 m along the dragger facing, casualty heading = dragger heading + 180 deg (head towards the dragger). Contact point = socket drag_handle (Spine1) at (0, 0.50, 0.42) in the casualty frame = (0, 0.50, 0.58) in the dragger frame (both hands).
medical.treat_wounded: medic kneels; the casualty (wounded_ground / wounded_sit) lies ~0.55 m in front of the medic root
medical.wounded_sit: back against a wall plane 0.30 m behind the root (-Z)

crawls.prone_crawl: military low crawl ("po-plastunski"), rebuilt: body flat on the ground (bare torso ~0.6 cm above it in every frame), rifle lying on the right forearm (right hand on the pistol grip = weapon_socket, left hand free), contralateral cycle (right elbow + left leg drive, then left elbow + right leg), frog-kick legs: the planted boot is still in the world (slides back at exactly ground_speed_mps in the in-place clip), the recovering leg slides forward with the knee out, boots never lifted; the chest rises / rolls over the pulling elbow so the elbow stays planted (< 5 cm creep).
crawls.wounded_crawl: belly drag, rebuilt: palms reach, plant (still in the world) and pull alternately, left leg short frog push, right leg dead (dragged, boot rolled out), head up; ground_speed_mps 0.24.

pistol.clips: pistol_idle (two-handed low ready) / pistol_aim (isosceles, right eye on the sight line) / pistol_fire (one shot, 0.267 s, first/last frame == pistol_aim frame 0, loops for follow-up shots, event shot at 0.0) / pistol_walk (aiming walk 1.47 m/s, gun stabilised) / pistol_run (compressed ready 4.17 m/s) / pistol_crouch_aim (kneeling aim)

vehicle_exits.clips: hatch_exit (= hatch_exit_tank, 4.4 s), hatch_exit_btr (4.2 s), dismount_jump (= dismount_jump_btr, 2.2 s), dismount_jump_tank (1.9 s), dismount_door (1.6 s), dismount_rear (1.3 s); all play once (names match the soldier.js once-regex: dismount*, hatch_exit*)
vehicle_exits.frame: clip frame = the soldier root at the END of the clip, on the ground, facing +Z (away from the vehicle). Root motion: the whole path from the vehicle is in the Hips translation track. The game places the root ONCE at that end position (y = ground) with heading = the clip +Z and does not move it while the clip plays (s.vel = 0, as now for jumpT / hatchT). No root-motion distance has to be applied.

placement.hatch_exit_tank: hatch rim centre at [0.25, 2.28, -1.92] from the root: root = hatch_xz + 1.92 m outward (perpendicular to the hull side the hatch is on) + 0.25 m toward the stern (the exit station is shifted aft to land on a fender stowage box, not the gap between boxes); heading = outward. T-72 commander hatch (right); gunner hatch (left) = the mirror with the same numbers.
placement.hatch_exit_btr: hatch rim centre at [0.0, 2.03, -1.7] from the root: root = hatch_xz + 1.70 m outward, same station along the hull; heading = outward. BTR-80/82 commander hatch (front right roof); driver hatch = the mirror.
placement.dismount_jump: ride_seat_N empty (edge seats) at [0.0, 1.995, -1.6] (BTR) / [0.0, 1.415, -1.2] (T-72) from the root: root = seat_xz + 1.60 m (BTR, dismount_jump / _btr) or 1.20 m (T-72, dismount_jump_tank) along the seat heading (outward), on the ground; heading = seat heading. Frame 0 == ride_sit_edge frame 0 at the seat (no pop from the riding loop). Deck seats (ride_sit_deck) have no matching start pose: crossfade, or walk them to an edge seat first.
placement.dismount_door: door sill (step) at [0.0, 0.85, -0.89] from the root: the root is the dismount_L / dismount_R empty of btr82a / btr80_ua (1.95 m off the hull axis at the door station z = -0.20, between axles 2 and 3); heading = outward (vehicle heading -/+ 90 deg). The vehicle models have the doors closed: open the upper leaf forward and fold the lower leaf down (step, 0.45 m) for the clip, or accept the body passing the door panel.
placement.dismount_rear: root = rear door threshold / ramp hinge + 0.55 m along -hull axis, on the ground; heading = hull backward. Floor / threshold height 0.50 m (param: clips_vehicle.LAYOUT["dismount_rear"]["threshold"], rebuild for BMP-3 / Bradley values, or offset the root y by (h - 0.50) for t < events.ground). A real ramp (Bradley) is a slope: play crouch_walk down it instead.

vehicle_exits.timing: hatch_exit*: events hatch_open (lid thrown open), out (body clear of the hatch, sitting on the rim), ground (feet on the ground), draw (= duration - 0.5: the PM appears in weapon_socket, soldier.js already shows it for hatchT < 0.5); set hatchT = clip duration (4.4 / 4.2 s, was 2.7). dismount_*: events land / ground (feet on the ground), out (through the door); set jumpT = clip duration (2.2 / 1.9 / 1.6 / 1.3 s, was 1.1).
vehicle_exits.continuity: dismount_jump*, dismount_door, dismount_rear end exactly in crouch_walk frame 0 (left foot forward, right heel up) with the hips moving forward at crouch_walk ground speed (0.93 m/s): start crouch_walk at time 0 (not a random phase) with the game root moving, or crossfade into crouch_idle / walk_rifle. hatch_exit* end in a crouch with the PM at a compressed low ready (crossfade into pistol_idle / pistol_walk / pistol_run).
vehicle_exits.vehicles_checked: check_anims.py tests the body against the actual vehicle GLBs (voxelised LOD0 meshes, hatch / door openings carved): hatch_exit_tank vs t72av_ua + t72b3, hatch_exit_btr / dismount_jump_btr / dismount_door vs btr82a + btr80_ua, dismount_jump_tank vs t72av_ua + t72b3. Known model obstacles ignored by the check: the AA machine gun on the T-72 cupola (t72av_ua: its barrel lies over the commander hatch; t72b3: outboard of it) and the T-72B3 cope cage (a crewman cannot stand up through it): hide / swing them for the bail-out or accept the clipping. Turret yaw: the tank clip assumes the turret facing forward.

deaths.summary: Direction / stance specific deaths (clips_death.py). Every death clip plays once, keeps root motion (the Hips track carries the body away from the root) and ends at rest on flat ground; events.drop_weapon = rifle leaves the hands; events.body_ground = the trunk lands; events.ragdoll = time from which src/game/ragdoll.js may take the body over (-1 = never: building / casualty clips).
deaths.direction: hit bearing = angle of (shooter or explosion - soldier) relative to his facing: "front" |bearing| < 49 deg, "back" > 132 deg, "left" / "right" = the soldier's own left / right side in between. _R / _L clips name the side the hit came FROM.
choice: was critical / stable (lying casualty) -> death_bleedout (never a standing clip)
inside a building window slot -> death_window_back (blast: always) / death_window_slump
rider on a vehicle deck -> death_headshot; squad.updateRiders puts him beside the vehicle, near the camera the ragdoll drops him from deck height (falls off the deck)

blast in front (< 52 deg) -> death_blast, the soldier is turned to face the explosion (thrown back away from it); blast from behind -> death_fall_forward; from a side -> death_spin_L / _R; blast deaths hand over to the ragdoll by 0.12 s with an impulse away from the explosion (scaled by the damage) and a backward tumble
standing, hit from the front -> death_fall_back 45 % / death_sit_slump 30 % / death_knees 15 % / death_crumple 10 %
standing, hit from behind -> death_fall_forward 75 % / death_knees 25 %; from the left -> death_spin_L; from the right -> death_spin_R
deaths.arms: both arms are simulated in the build (verlet elbow + wrist hanging from the animated shoulder: gravity, residual tone fading as he goes down, ground friction, torso / thigh / head capsules, hinge elbows, shoulder limits) and solved back with two-bone IK
deaths.feet: feet are pinned to their ground spots while they carry weight (leg IK, IK swing between steps); no foot sliding
deaths.window: building clips: kneeling at the window slot (buildings.js slotPos): inner wall face 0.60 m ahead of the root (+Z), sill 0.86 m
deaths.ragdoll: game side (src/game/ragdoll.js): position-based dynamics on 19 joint particles, ground = city.groundHeight, max 8 active, only within ~90 m camera distance and never inside buildings / aboard; on level ground (< 8 cm under every joint now and in the clip's last frame) the authored clip ends the death and no ragdoll runs; otherwise it takes over at events.ragdoll, or earlier (after 0.3 s) as soon as the ground under the Hips is > 0.25 m above / below the root (trench edge, slope, rubble: the clip assumes flat ground); a new ragdoll only starts when a slot is free or the oldest body has settled > 1.4 s (never frozen mid-air: otherwise the clip finishes); blasts always ragdoll from 0.12 s with an impulse away from the explosion; asleep once the trunk moves < 1.5 cm in 0.35 s (typically 0.7-1.8 s, at most 3 s), then frozen (no per-frame cost); the soldier's pos moves to where the pelvis rests. Without a ragdoll the clip plays to its end, then the corpse is frozen and pos moves to the end Hips position (root motion).

medevac.summary: Casualty evacuation with the pickup (assets/vehicles/pickup.glb, src/game/medevac.js, clips_medevac.py). Medic and casualty clips come in pairs that share the root: the game puts the casualty's root on the medic's root with the same heading and keeps the casualty clip time equal to the medic's (medevac_lift + wounded_lifted, medevac_carry_walk + wounded_carry_walk, medevac_load_bed + wounded_load_bed).
medevac.cab: medevac_cab_exit / medevac_cab_enter: clip frame = the end root on the ground beside the door facing away from the truck; the cab seat H-point (ride_seat_2 / ride_seat_3 of pickup.glb) is events.seat_root_frame in that frame (+X = the truck's front for right-hand doors): root = seat + 0.62 m outward + 0.10 m forward. The door (door_FR / door_RR hinge, manifest vehicles.pickup.doors) opens at the start.
medevac.lift: medevac_lift: the casualty lies events.casualty_root_frame ahead of the medic (on his back, head to the medic's left); ends in medevac_carry_walk frame 0 (the casualty over the right shoulder).
medevac.load: medevac_load_bed: the medic stands at load_point (behind the open tailgate, facing the truck) shifted sideways by the stretcher slot's x; wounded_load_bed ends exactly in wounded_on_bed frame 0 at that stretcher_N empty (turned 180 deg: the empty's +Z faces the tailgate).
medevac.bed: wounded_on_bed: lying on the back, floor at y = 0 of the root frame, head towards -Z; root = stretcher_N empty.
medevac.weapon: medevac_* clips: rifle slung on the back (weapon_socket_back); wounded_*: slung / dropped as for the other wounded clips.

v8.summary: infantry anim v8: stance / weapon matched reloads, per-shot procedural recoil with support-hand IK, varied deaths (src/game/soldier.js + src/game/soldierPose.js; clips from clips_v8.py)
v8.reloads: game picks reload_stand / reload_crouch / reload_prone (AK family) or reload_mg_prone / reload_mg_crouch (PKM; a standing gunner uses reload_stand) and time-scales the clip (0.6-1.6) so it ends back on the aim pose when the reload finishes. Emergency reload (magazine empty): the empty is let go ~0.1 s after mag_out and falls to the ground (lies there 60 s), the hand comes back from the pouch (events.pouch[0]) with the new one; tactical reload (topping up in a lull, magazine < 1/3): the part-used magazine is retained (clip as authored), its rounds pooled.
v8.recoil: fire_* clips are no longer played: the aim / peek clip stays on and every round fired kicks damped springs (muzzle flip = RightArm about the shoulder, chest rock = Spine 40 % + Spine1 60 %, neck counter-rock, random yaw drift) with per-weapon strength (AK-74 2.6 deg flip / 1.4 deg rock, AK-12 2.2 / 1.2, PKM 3.4 / 2.0 and x0.35 on the bipod prone, PM 9 deg wrist flip) and stance factors (crouch 0.9 / 0.8, prone 0.6 / 0.45); the left hand is held on the weapon by two-bone IK while it moves.
v8.deaths: clip by stance, hit bearing, hit region (leg -> death_knees / death_crumple), speed (walking > 0.9 m/s -> forward momentum, running -> death_run) and blast size (death_blast only for a big burst in front, power >= 130; smaller blasts knock the man down with a modest ragdoll impulse); each death plays at 0.88-1.12x with a procedural hit jolt (chest back / twist / lean away from the hit), loose arm and head flail that dies out before the body lands, and a lasting random head turn.
